candidate_freeze.note: The v4 candidate freeze configs/research_v4_candidate_freeze.json is the artifact that freezes the candidate set; it is produced after this manifest and is referenced by it, not the other way round. A freeze amendment records the validated subset once the validation outcome is known.

code_hash_note: code_hash is the authorized value of record for the hashed set, cross-checked against research_state/campaign_authorization.json. The ordered digest is checkout-dependent (BRAIN-009); canonical_source_digest is the portable identity of the tree and the live ordered digest is an environment fact, never an identity.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest body with the manifest_hash key removed. The snapshot_identity.data_manifest_hash is the manifest_hash of research/data_manifest_v4.json.

market_cap_source.note: Current-universe snapshot used; historical point-in-time ranks unavailable. Results have survivorship limitations.

prerequisite_status.note: configs/research_v4.json is immutable and still records P2 and P3 as OUTSTANDING; that statement describes the specification's own scope at freeze time and is not rewritten here. Flipping it requires a versioned amendment to the specification.

supersedes.note: The v3 universe manifest is immutable and is not edited by this version; the v4 universe is the next batch below the recomputed v3 floor, and no v4 constituent is an asset of the v1, v2 or v3 universe.

survivorship_disclaimer: This universe uses one current market-cap snapshot (2026-10-20T23:50:06Z) from CoinGecko. Historical point-in-time market-cap data is not available from a verifiably free source. This universe has survivorship and selection bias limitations. Assets that have fallen out of the top 20 or delisted are excluded. Do not describe this as a historically point-in-time-selected market portfolio.
